scenes.title: THE JOB SEARCH LOOP
scenes.narration: A job search sounds simple, but it quickly becomes five separate jobs: find roles, check sponsorship, compare your skills, rewrite your resume, and track every application. The traditional way spreads that work across job boards, documents, inboxes, and spreadsheets. MindKraft brings the journey together.
